summary_en: The study tests FT536, an allogeneic natural killer (NK) cell immunotherapy, in adults with recurrent WHO Grade 4 astrocytoma. FT536 is injected once into the tumor during a biopsy procedure, at doses of 1 x 10^7, 2 x 10^7, or 6 x 10^7 cells per dose, and maximum safe surgical resection follows between Study Day 8 and 15. The primary outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1 study that compares tumor samples taken before and after the injection.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa FT536, una inmunoterapia alogénica con células asesinas naturales (NK), en adultos con astrocitoma recurrente de grado 4 de la OMS. FT536 se inyecta una sola vez dentro del tumor durante un procedimiento de biopsia, en dosis de 1 x 10^7, 2 x 10^7 o 6 x 10^7 células por dosis, y luego se realiza una resección quirúrgica máxima segura entre los días 8 y 15 del estudio. La medida principal de resultado no se indica; es un estudio de fase 1 que compara muestras de tumor tomadas antes y después de la inyección.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 75 years at consent.
Histologically confirmed WHO Grade 4 astrocytoma with first or second recurrence on MRI.
Gross tumor resection must be feasible as judged by the investigator and neurosurgeon.
Completed standard treatment, including surgery, radiation, and temozolomide with or without tumor treating fields.
Karnofsky performance status of 70 or higher, off dexamethasone or on 2 mg daily or less.
not_for: Need for urgent neurosurgery, high intracranial pressure, or uncontrolled seizures.
History of myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia.
Prior bevacizumab or any other cellular therapy.
Any condition requiring systemic immunosuppressive therapy.
